extraction.Name: Rose Cordier (Setter)
extraction.Recorded patent: The instrument was recorded Sept. 30, 1920 by Rose Cordier Wolf Setter
extraction.Buyer: Frank O. Setter conveyed the land to Sol L. Degen for $4400.00; Degen and his wife gave Rose Cordier Wolf Setter a mortgage on the land for $2800.00, due in five yearly installments
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 732782 issued; northwest quarter of section 10, township 99, range 76; receipt for patent signed April 2, 1920 by Rose Cordier Wolf Setter; conveyance dated April 16, 1928; allottee formerly known as Rose Cordier
